{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 300 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Broad Bean|broad beans]] (fresh or canned)
* 1 [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* 2 strips of [[Cookbook:Ham|ham]] or [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]] (or [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|vegetarian]] bacon) 
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]

== Procedure ==
# [[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] onions and ham in a pan with a little olive oil.  
# Add the broad beans and [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] for a few minutes until the beans are soft.
# Serve hot.
